string.text: Deliver a Tushkano head
Sakharov needs an intact Tushkano head to study as part of an experiment.
Deliver a Chimera claw
Sakharov is researching the chemical structure of the Chimera's claw, and needs one to study.
Deliver a Bloodsucker's tentacles
Sakharov is studying the saliva of the Bloodsucker to produce a powerful coagulant and needs the tentacles from a Bloodsucker.
Deliver a Boar's hoof
Sakharov needs a Boar's hoof to produce some more antiradation drugs.
Deliver a Flesh eye
Sakharov wants to study the Flesh mutant, and has requested the eye of one.
Deliver a Snork's leg
Sakharov wants to understand more on how the snork can make it's unbelievable jumps, and needs the foot of one to study.
Deliver a Spring artifact
Sakharov wishes to study a Spring artifact, to determine it's properties.
Deliver a Battery artifact
Sakharov wants to study the rare form of the Battery artifact, to discover what makes it form differently.
Deliver a Pellicle artifact
Sakharov wants to study the structure of the Pellicle artifact and figure out what makes it such a potent absorber of chemical gases.
Deliver the artifact known as Mama's Beads
Sakharov wants to analyse the emissions produced by the Mama's Beads to figure out how it affects the bodies metabolism.
Deliver the Firefly artifact
Sakharov wants a better understanding of how the Firefly artifact causes increased cellular activity.
Deliver the Soul artifact
Sakharov needs a Soul artifact to conduct an experiment on.
Deliver the Thorn artifact
Sakharov requires a Thorn artifact to study it's effects on reducing radiation in the human body.
